login.title: Login with AigoSmart account
login.description:
Enter your AigoSmart account credentials.

All connected bulbs will be discovered automatically.

token_bypass.title: Manual token entry
token_bypass.description:
Enter a session captured from the AigoSmart app (e.g. with mitmproxy).
Use this when the standard login keeps asking for a security code.
The iotToken is short-lived but is refreshed automatically via the refreshToken.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.description:
A verification code has been sent to your email.
Please enter the code below.

error.cannot_connect: Login failed. Check email and password.
error.invalid_token: Token invalid or expired. Capture fresh tokens and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs.

sync_devices.name: Sync devices
sync_devices.description: Re-discover all devices from your Aigostar account and add new ones.

dump_tsl.name: Dump device models
dump_tsl.description: Write each device's TSL model and current property values to the Home Assistant log. Use this to report unsupported features (for example the colour property of a Bluetooth Mesh bulb).
